# Lightweight Charts Line Tools vendor bundle

These browser-ready UMD files are committed so the review workspace can run offline with
`python study_server.py`; Node.js and npm are not required at runtime.

| File | Upstream package | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `core.min.js` | `difurious/lightweight-charts-line-tools-core` | 1.1.2 |
| `lines.min.js` | `difurious/lightweight-charts-line-tools-lines` | 1.1.0 |
| `fib-retracement.min.js` | `difurious/lightweight-charts-line-tools-fib-retracement` | 1.1.0 |
| `rectangle.min.js` | `difurious/lightweight-charts-line-tools-rectangle` | 1.1.0 |
| `parallel-channel.min.js` | `difurious/lightweight-charts-line-tools-parallel-channel` | 1.1.0 |

The files were built from the upstream `main` snapshots retrieved on 2026-07-17, against
Lightweight Charts 5.2.0. Each package is licensed under MPL-2.0; the corresponding license
text is stored next to the bundle.
